turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hey Dev. How are you holding up today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Honestly, pretty surprised. An unexpected email popped into my inbox this morning.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Surprises can go either way in a job search. What landed in your inbox?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, you remember Tarnwell, right? A recruiter from Tarnwell actually reached out to me today about a junior analyst role on a completely different team over there.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is a real turn after last month. How did it feel when you saw their name again?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: At first I was bracing for some automated rejection survey or something. But she said they liked my background from before, and this position opened up under a different manager.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: It means you left a solid impression even when that first team passed. Did she mention what the next step looks like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, she asked if I'm open to doing a quick introductory phone chat sometime early next week to go over the scope.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That sounds like a comfortable way back into conversation with them. Are you leaning toward taking the call?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, definitely. I replied and said I'd love to chat. I guess I'm just trying not to get my hopes up too much after what happened the first round.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is very natural. A different team often means an entirely fresh slate, though. What feels different to you this time around?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Well, back in September I froze a bit on the technical side and doubted everything. But I've had more practice since then, so I feel a little steadier.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: You have logged a lot of hours since that first screen. Would you like to practice a quick introduction for that recruiter call, or just take today to let the news settle?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think I just want to let it sink in today, maybe review the job description tonight and take a breather.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Giving yourself room to breathe is a good call. Do you want to check in again once you lock down a time for the call?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, let's do that. Once she confirms the day, I'll hop back on here and we can prep. Thanks, Wren.
